blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent work on language-model adaptation has shown that single models can obtain informative training signals by evaluating their behavior in demonstration- or feedback-augmented contexts, with the help of a teacher network, which is driven by the students’ learned parameters. Inspired by this internal-reference principle, we investigate how diffusion models can identify self-referenced training signals without external demonstrations or teacher networks. We introduce SALD, a self-referenced training framework that evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels using the same model. The easier, lower-noise path is evaluated without gradient tracking to provide a reference, while the harder, higher-noise path provides the training gradient. Rather than directly distilling the easy-path prediction, SALD uses the difference between two path errors to adapt the hard-path objective. The proposed Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts this relative error into a differentiable sample-level weight. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) accumulates relative difficulty across training and adapts the future gap between the two noise levels. Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) further compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight. All components share a single set of model parameters, requiring neither an external teacher network nor additional trainable parameters during training or inference, and no modification to the inference procedure. Experiments across multiple architectures and datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in generation quality, while component-wise ablations quantify the contributions of the proposed components.
blocks.zh: 最近关于语言模型适应的研究表明,单一模型可以在教师网络的帮助下,通过评估其在示范或反馈环境中的行为,获得信息性的培训信号,而教师网络是由学生的学习参数驱动的。 在这种内部参考原则的启发下,我们调查传播模型如何在没有外部演示或教师网络的情况下识别自我参考的培训信号. 我们引入了SALD,一个自引用的训练框架,使用同一模型在两个噪声级别上评价每个图像封装对. 在不进行梯度跟踪的情况下,对比较容易的低噪路径进行评估,以提供参考,而比较困难的,高噪路径则提供训练梯度. blocks.en:
Diffusion Ho et al. (2020) ; Song et al. (2020) and flow-matching Lipman et al. (2022) ; Albergo et al. (2025) based generative models have become
standard backbones for high-fidelity image synthesis, with Diffusion
Transformers further improving scalability and generation quality Peebles and Xie (2023) . In parallel, recent work on language-model
adaptation has shown that a model can obtain richer online training signals by
evaluating its behavior under additional information. Self-Distillation
Fine-Tuning conditions a self-teacher on expert demonstrations, whereas
Self-Distillation Policy Optimization conditions a self-teacher on feedback
obtained from the model’s own attempts Shenfeld et al. (2026) ; Hübotter et al. (2026) . These approaches
show that useful supervision can be constructed without relying on a stronger
external teacher. Transferring this principle to diffusion training is not
straightforward: diffusion models do not naturally receive textual
demonstrations or retrospective feedback, and their training states are sampled
from a prescribed corruption process rather than from autoregressive policy
rollouts. Moreover, standard diffusion objectives still average gradients
uniformly across training pairs and latent elements, although their difficulty
varies substantially across images, captions, noise levels, and visual details Vincent (2011) ; Choi et al. (2022) . Neural networks also exhibit
spectral bias, learning coarse low-frequency structure before fine
high-frequency detail Rahaman et al. (2019) ; Wang and Pehlevan (2025a) . Consequently,
uniform training can continue to emphasize already learned signals while
underweighting examples and visual components that remain difficult.

Can a diffusion model construct its own easier reference and use it to adapt training across harder examples, prompts, noise levels, and visual frequencies,
without teachers, demonstrations, or feedback datasets?

没有教师、示威或反馈数据集?

blocks.en:
A unified answer remains missing because existing methods address only parts of
this problem. Noise-level weighting Karras et al. (2022) ; Esser et al. (2024) ; Hang et al. (2025) adjusts training according to timestep or signal-to-noise ratio, but normally
applies the same rule to all examples evaluated at a given noise level. Noise
selection methods show that different noise instances provide unequal training
signals Qi et al. (2024a) , but they do not maintain a persistent estimate
of how the difficulty of an individual image-caption pair changes throughout
training. Curriculum learning Bengio et al. (2009) orders examples by
difficulty, but typically depends on a fixed or externally defined curriculum
and are not adaptive noise selection. Distributionally robust optimization emphasizes difficult subpopulations Sagawa et al. (2019) , whereas frequency-aware objectives address spectral
imbalance; neither directly combines the sample-level, temporal, and spectral
difficulty in diffusion training. Likewise, demonstration- or
feedback-conditioned language-model self-distillation cannot be transferred
directly because diffusion training provides neither an in-context
demonstration, nor a feedback-conditioned output distribution to distill Shenfeld et al. (2026) ; Hübotter et al. (2026) . These limitations
motivate a self-referenced diffusion objective in which an easier view of the
same training pair provides a relative difficulty signal rather than a teacher
prediction target.

blocks.en:
We introduce SALD, which evaluates every
image-caption pair at two noise levels using one shared model: an easier
low-noise path and a harder high-noise path. The easy path is evaluated without
gradient tracking and serves as an internal reference, while model parameters
are updated through the hard path. SALD does not directly distill the easy-path
prediction into the hard path. Instead, it measures the increase in weighted
prediction error from the easy path to the hard path and uses this relative
signal to adapt the hard-path objective. Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts the scalar error difference into a normalized, differentiable
sample weight, emphasizing training pairs whose error grows under the harder
condition. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) maintains an exponential
moving average of relative difficulty for every training pair and uses it to
adapt future noise-level gaps, forming a continuous per-example curriculum Bengio et al. (2009) . Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD)
compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a
differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight, providing a finer
training signal related to spectral bias Rahaman et al. (2019) ; Wang and Pehlevan (2025a) . All components reuse the same set
of model parameters and require neither a teacher network nor
additional trainable model parameters during training or inference. The
method introduces no change to the inference procedure. Our contributions are
summarized as follows: • We introduce AGD, a self-referenced weighting mechanism that estimates
sample importance from the relative error between hard and easy noise paths,
without any teachers, demonstration datasets, or architectural changes. • We introduce TAM and SAD to extend relative difficulty across training
history and spectral structure, enabling an adaptive per-example noise
curriculum and frequency-derived, latent-element weighting. • We characterize the optimization behavior of the resulting
differentiable weighting objective and evaluate SALD across multiple
architectures and datasets. The experiments demonstrate consistent gains
in generation quality, while component-wise ablations quantify the
contributions of AGD, TAM, and SAD.

blocks.en: 2 Proposed Approach
blocks.zh: 2 拟议办法

blocks.en: The same diffusion model evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels. The lower-noise evaluation forms an easy path , which is computed without gradient tracking and serves as an internal reference. The higher-noise evaluation forms a hard path , through which the model parameters are updated. By comparing these paths, SALD addresses three questions: (i) Which examples are currently difficult? (ii) How large should the easy-to-hard noise gap be for each example? and (iii) At which frequencies does the hard-path residual remain large? Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD), Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM), and Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) address these questions, respectively. All components share the same model parameters; therefore, SALD requires neither an external teacher nor an additional trainable model during training or inference.
blocks.zh: 同样的扩散模型在两个噪声级别上评价每个图像封装对. 低噪音评价是一条简单的道路,在不进行梯度跟踪的情况下进行计算,并作为内部参考。 高噪声评价形成一条硬路,通过这条路更新模型参数. 通过对这些路径的比较,SALD解决了三个问题:(一) 哪些实例目前比较困难? (二) 对于每个例子而言,容易变硬的噪音间隙应有多大? 和(三) 硬通路残存的频率是多少? 优异的导引分解(AGD),Temperal advantage memory(TAM),以及光谱优异分解(SAD)分别解决这些问题. 所有组件都具有相同的模型参数;因此,SALD在培训或推论期间既不需要外部教师,也不需要额外的可训练模型.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol. We evaluate generated images using Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) Heusel et al. (2018) , CLIP score Radford et al. (2021) , and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) Zhang et al. (2018) . FID measures distributional similarity to real images (quality and diversity). FID is computed using the Inception-V3 network with 2048-dimensional pool features. CLIP Score is computed using the CLIP ViT-L/14 model from OpenAI. LPIPS is computed using a VGG backbone. Further details are mentioned in Appendix D.1 .

blocks.en: 3.1 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 3.1 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Quantitative Analysis: Tables 1 , and 2 report quantitative comparisons across seven benchmarks at 512 512 and 1024 1024 resolutions. SALD consistently outperforms the competing acceleration and distillation baselines, including SpeeD Wang et al. (2025) , Temporal Diff Ying et al. (2026) , and SRA Jiang et al. (2025) , across both SANA, PixArt and Flux.2 Klein architectures. In particular, SALD achieves the best FID, CLIP, and LPIPS scores across the majority of evaluated settings, demonstrating its ability to simultaneously improve generation fidelity, text-image alignment, and perceptual quality. The improvements are consistent across different model scales and datasets, with particularly substantial FID reductions observed at both 512 512 and 1024 1024 resolutions. Compared with the existing baselines, these results demonstrate that SALD provides a more effective and consistent strategy for improving diffusion model generation quality while preserving semantic alignment.

blocks.en: Case 1: Individual Contributions. AGD contributes most strongly among individual components, as direct difficulty-aware reweighting provides an immediate training signal. SAD offers complementary gains through spectral routing, improving structural fidelity at the cost of modest CLIP degradation. TAM alone yields the weakest improvement, since its EMA-based memory requires a sustained difficulty signal from AGD to stabilise, a notable limitation when used in isolation. Together, all three components are necessary to close the full performance gap.

blocks.en:
Denoising diffusion models Ho et al. (2020) and score-based generative models Song et al. (2020) established iterative denoising as a powerful paradigm for image synthesis. Flow matching Lipman et al. (2022) ; Albergo et al. (2025) provides
a continuous-time alternative by learning velocity fields along interpolation paths. Recent transformer-based generators, including DiT Peebles and Xie (2023) , rectified-flow transformers Esser et al. (2024) , SANA Xie et al. (2024) ,
PixArt- α \alpha Chen et al. (2023) , and PixArt- Σ \Sigma Chen et al. (2024) , further improve scalability and high-resolution generation. However, most objectives still
treat samples, timesteps, and spatial locations uniformly. Several works improve training by reallocating the gradient budget across noise levels. EDM Karras et al. (2022) studies principled noise schedules and σ \sigma -weighting, while P2 Choi et al. (2022) emphasizes perceptually important SNR regions. Improved noise schedules Hang et al. (2025) and noise-instance analysis Qi et al. (2024a) further show that different noise levels and noise samples provide unequal training signals. These approaches define global timestep-dependent weights, whereas AGD computes per-sample relative difficulty from the loss gap between low- and high-noise paths.

Our work is also related to curriculum learning Bengio et al. (2009) , self-paced learning Kumar et al. (2010) , dynamic instance hardness Chang et al. (2020) , adaptive curricula Kong and others (2021) , diffusion curricula Liang et al. (2025) , and adaptive point-weighting Li et al. (2025) . Hard-example mining Felzenszwalb et al. (2010) ; Shrivastava et al. (2016) and DRO Sagawa et al. (2020) ; Feoktistov et al. (2025) ; Ma et al. Unlike these methods, TAM stores an EMA of relative advantage and uses it to adapt the timestep gap for each sample. Finally, SAD connects to spectral bias studies Rahaman et al. (2019) ; Xu et al. Instead of modifying the architecture, sampler, or noising process, SAD uses contrastive spectral residuals to construct spatial importance weights for loss reweighting. Recent work uses feedback-conditioned output distribution to distill Shenfeld et al. (2026) ; Hübotter et al. (2026) from teacher to student in the language domain but requires demonstration example and EMA based teacher. The proposed model can be seen as distillation from easy to hard sample, however it does not requires extra copy of the model parameters.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented SALD, a unified training framework for flow-based diffusion models that reallocates gradient budget across samples, noise levels, and frequency components. AGD estimates relative sample difficulty by contrasting losses between low and high-noise states, producing normalized within-batch importance weights. TAM extends this signal across the training set through persistent per-sample memory, enabling an adaptive curriculum over timestep gaps. SAD further refines optimization by converting contrastive spectral residuals into frequency-derived latent weights, emphasizing frequency patterns that remain under-learned. Since only the easy-path reference is detached, SALD preserves the original prediction target while improving where and how training effort is applied. In general, SALD offers a simple, architecture-agnostic approach for improving diffusion training without modifying the model, sampler, or inference procedure. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and architectures demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, while theoretical analysis supports the empirical findings.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个基于流动的传播模型的统一培训框架,将梯度预算重新分配到样本、噪音水平和频率部分。 AGD通过对比低噪音状态和高噪音状态之间的损失来估计相对的样本难度,产生正常的批次内重要重量. TAM通过持续的每个样本记忆将这一信号延伸至整个培训中,使课程适应性能够跨越时间间隔。 SAD通过将对比光谱残基转换成频率衍生的潜在权重,进一步细化优化,强调仍然学习不足的频率模式. 由于只分离出简单路径参考,SALD保留了最初的预测目标,同时改进了培训工作的地点和方式。 一般来说,SALD提供了一个简单的,结构-不可知的方法,在不修改模型,采样器或推论程序的情况下,改进传播培训. 各种数据集和结构的广泛实验表明拟议框架的有效性,而理论分析则支持实证结论。

blocks.en:
The standard flow-matching loss used in Section 2.1 averages the losses of all
training samples and all elements of their latent residuals. Apart from the
time-dependent factor w ⁡ ( t ) w(t) , it assigns the same explicit coefficient to every
sample and latent element. This does not mean that all samples produce equal
gradients; samples with larger residuals can naturally produce larger gradient
magnitudes. Rather, the objective has no explicit mechanism for adapting a
sample’s importance according to its current difficulty or for distinguishing
the frequency content of its remaining residual. This uniform treatment leads
to two limitations that can become more important as training progresses,
especially during domain-specific fine-tuning.

blocks.en:
The second limitation concerns the frequency content of the residual within
each image. Deep networks are known to learn low-frequency content faster than
high-frequency content, a behavior referred to as spectral bias or the
frequency principle Rahaman et al. (2019) ; Xu et al. (2020) . Related
frequency-dependent behavior has also been studied in diffusion models Yang et al. (2023) ; Si et al. (2024) ; Wang and Pehlevan (2025a) . Smooth structures such
as skies and walls may be reconstructed earlier, whereas fine details such as
hair strands, feather textures, specular highlights, and small text can lag
behind. However, the standard mean-squared error collapses the full latent
residual into a single scalar and does not explicitly indicate which frequency
bands retain comparatively large error. Importantly, frequency magnitude does
not identify the spatial locations of those errors because the power spectrum
discards Fourier phase. The relevant goal is therefore to identify difficult
frequency components and use them to construct a frequency-derived latent
weight, rather than to claim a localized pixel-level error map.

blocks.en:
One natural idea is curriculum learning Bengio et al. (2009) ; Kumar et al. (2010) , in which easy samples are shown
first and harder samples are introduced later. Classical curricula, however,
often rely on a fixed notion of difficulty. In diffusion training, a sample’s
difficulty changes as the model improves, so a static ordering can quickly
become stale. What is needed instead is a strategy that (i) measures which
samples become difficult relative to the current model when noise is increased,
(ii) remembers this relative difficulty across training steps, and (iii)
identifies which residual frequencies remain difficult. Unlike
demonstration- or feedback-conditioned language-model self-distillation Shenfeld et al. (2026) ; Hübotter et al. (2026) , SALD constructs
its reference from two noise states of the same image–caption pair: a
lower-noise easy path evaluated without gradient tracking and a higher-noise
hard path that supplies the training gradient. Advantage-Guided Diffusion
(AGD) performs differentiable sample-level reweighting, Temporal Advantage
Memory (TAM) maintains persistent relative-difficulty estimates and adapts
future noise gaps, and Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) constructs a
frequency-derived latent weight. These components share one set of model
parameters and require no external teacher or additional model copy during
training or inference.

blocks.en:
Algorithm 1 summarizes a single SALD training step. Given a mini-batch of
image–caption pairs, we first determine a base noise-level gap using a simple
curriculum: during warm-up, the gap increases from 1 1 to Δ \Delta , after which it is sampled uniformly from { 1 , … , Δ } \{1,\ldots,\Delta\} . This base gap is then modulated for each
sample using Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM), which scales the gap according
to the sample’s stored difficulty score and clips it to the valid range. For
each example, we sample a lower-noise easy level and obtain the corresponding
higher-noise hard level by adding the TAM-adjusted gap. Two noisy views of the
same latent are then constructed using independent Gaussian perturbations.
The same model performs two forward passes: the easy path is evaluated under no_grad and serves as an internal reference, whereas the hard path
remains differentiable and supplies the training gradient. From the residuals
of these two paths, Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) compares their
frequency-domain error magnitudes and maps a zero-phase spectral gate back to
the latent coordinates to obtain a frequency-derived weighting kernel. Since
this construction does not retain the residual phase or recover the locations
of the original errors, the kernel should not be interpreted as a localized
pixel-level advantage map. Instead, it reweights the hard-path residual loss
using the relative spectral errors of the two paths. In parallel,
Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) defines the sample advantage as the
difference between the differentiable hard-path loss and the stop-gradient
easy-path reference loss. It converts this advantage into a normalized sample
weight that emphasizes harder examples within the batch. Finally, TAM stores
the numerical advantage for future visits to the sample; the memory is
non-trainable, and no gradient is propagated through this state update. The
SALD objective is then formed by averaging the sample-weighted SAD losses of
the hard paths before backpropagation. In this way, the algorithm adapts the
training signal across samples, noise levels, and spectral components through
a dynamic, self-referenced curriculum.

Table 4 summarizes the implementation details of all backbone architectures used in our experiments. blocks.en: D.2 Wall-Clock Evaluation
blocks.zh: D.2 墙钟评价

blocks.en: We further evaluate the training efficiency of SALD under a matched wall-clock budget. As shown in Table 5 , SALD incurs approximately 25 % 25\% additional wall-clock time per training step compared with the corresponding baseline, measured on the same NVIDIA RTX A6000 setup. This overhead comes from the additional easy noise reference path: SALD performs gradient computation and backpropagation only for the hard noise path, while the easy noise path is evaluated without gradient computation, requiring only an additional forward pass. To account for this overhead, SALD is trained for 10 10 k steps, while the baselines are trained for 12.5 12.5 k steps. Thus, the total training budgets are approximately matched, since 10 ​ k × 1.25 ≈ 12.5 ​ k 10\text{k}\times 1.25\approx 12.5\text{k} . As reported in Table 5 , under this comparable wall-clock budget, SALD consistently achieves better generation quality across both CUB-200 and MultiGen datasets. In particular, SALD improves FID, CLIP, and LPIPS over the corresponding baseline models across all evaluated backbone configurations. These results show that the limited additional cost introduced by the no-gradient reference path is compensated by SALD’s faster convergence, allowing it to achieve superior generation quality within approximately the same overall training time as the baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估了在相应时速预算下SALD的培训效率。 如表5所示,与同一NVIDIA RTX A6000设置中测得的相应基线相比,SALD每个培训步骤增加约25%的25小时。 这种俯冲来自额外的简单噪声参考路径: SALD只为硬噪声路径进行梯度计算和反向传播,而简单噪声路径则在不进行梯度计算的情况下进行评估,只需要额外的前行通道. 为计算这一间接费用,SALD培训了10个10千步,而基线培训了12.5个12.5千步。 因此,培训预算总额大致相当,因为10 k × 1.25 → 12.5 k 10\ text{k}\times 1.25\约 12.5\ text{k}。 如表5所报告,在这一可比的时钟预算下,SALD在CUB-200和MultiGen数据集中始终实现更好的生成质量。 特别是,SALD改进了FID、CLIP和LPIPS,以取代所有评价骨干配置的相应基准模型。 这些结果表明,无阶梯参照路径引入的有限额外成本得到了SALD更快的趋同的补偿,使其能够在与基线大致相同的总培训时间内达到更高的生成质量。

blocks.en: Table 6 reveals a consistent sampling-efficiency advantage of SALD across model scales, from SANA 0.6B/1.6B to PixArt- Σ \Sigma 0.6B, on Oxford Flowers. As the number of inference steps is reduced, SALD preserves generation quality more effectively than the corresponding Base models, yielding lower FID and LPIPS while retaining comparable or higher CLIP scores. In particular, for both SANA models, SALD at 15 steps attains lower FID than the Base model at 20 steps (30.60 vs. 33.11 for SANA 1.6B and 25.54 vs. 30.64 for SANA 0.6B), using 25% fewer sampling steps, although LPIPS and CLIP at 15 steps remain slightly below the 20-step Base values.
blocks.zh: 表6显示SALD在牛津花卉上从SANA 0.6B/1.6B到PixArt-\\Sigma 0.6B之间具有一致的抽样效率优势。 随着推论步骤的减少,SALD比相应的Base模型更有效保存生成质量,产生较低的FID和LPIPS,同时保留可比或更高的CLIP分数. 特别是,对于两个SANA模型,15步的SALD在20步(SANA 1.6B对33.11,SANA 0.6B对25.54对30.64)得到比Base模型更低的FID,使用抽样步骤减少25%,不过15步的LPIPS和CLIP仍然略低于20步的Base值。

blocks.en: The behavior is consistent with the relative error signal introduced in Eq. 6 . Instead of treating prediction errors at different noise states independently, SALD contrasts the hard and easy states of the same sample and assigns greater importance when the harder state exhibits a larger error. Through the AGD weighting in Eq. 7 , optimization therefore concentrates on trajectory regions where prediction remains comparatively difficult. This encourages more accurate learning of the velocity field along challenging portions of the noise trajectory, which in turn reduces the dependence on densely spaced inference updates. The cross-scale results in Table 6 suggest that this effect is not specific to a particular architecture size, but translates into consistently stronger quality–efficiency trade-offs across the evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 行为与Eq中引入的相对错误信号一致. 6 (中文(简体) ). SALD不独立地处理不同噪声的预测错误,而是对比同一样本的硬度和容易的状态,并在硬度显示较大错误时给予更大的重视. 因此,通过Eq.7中的AGD加权法,优化的重点是预测仍然相对困难的轨迹区域。 这鼓励在噪声轨迹有挑战性的部分沿途更准确地了解速度场,这反过来又减少了对空间密集的推论更新的依赖。 表6中的跨尺度结果表明,这种影响并非特定建筑规模所特有的,而是在所评价的模型之间形成持续更强的质量和效率权衡。

blocks.en: Furthermore, Figure 8 provides a qualitative view of this faster inference-time convergence using SANA 1.6B trained on DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 1M. The distinction is most pronounced at low sampling budgets. SALD establishes the correct facial structure and overall appearance within the first few steps, with the 10-step output already closely resembling its 15- and 20-step generations. In contrast, the baseline remains highly unstable at 5 and 10 steps, exhibiting substantial changes in geometry, illumination, and color before converging toward a consistent image at later steps. Thus, additional sampling primarily refines the SALD output rather than correcting its global structure, whereas the baseline requires more iterations to stabilize both structure and appearance. This visual progression further supports that SALD learns a more efficient generation trajectory, allowing coherent samples to emerge under substantially fewer inference steps.
blocks.zh: 此外,图8利用在DALL \\cdot E 3 1M上培训的SANA 1.6B提供了这种更快的推论时间趋同的定性观点。 这种区别在低抽样预算中最为明显。 SALD在最初的几个步骤中建立了正确的面部结构和整体外观,10步输出已经紧密地与它的15和20步一代相似. 相比之下,基线在5和10个步骤上仍然非常不稳定,在几何、照明和颜色方面出现重大变化,然后在以后的步骤上向一致的图像汇合。 因此,更多的抽样主要改进了SALD的产出,而不是纠正其全球结构,而基线需要更多的迭代来稳定结构和外观。 这种视觉进步进一步支持了SALD学习更高效的生成轨迹,使得一致的样本能够在大量较少的推断步骤下出现.

blocks.en: D.4 What happens if we train 10 × \times More?
blocks.zh: D.4 国家 如果我们再训练10次会怎么样?

blocks.en: To examine whether the gains reported at the main training budget are a consequence of insufficient training of the Baseline, we extend both the Baseline and SALD models to 100 100 k training steps, corresponding to 10 × 10\times the standard 10 10 k-step training budget. Table 7 reports the results across SANA 1.6B and SANA 0.6B on the MultiGen and Oxford 102 Flowers datasets. SALD maintains a consistent FID advantage over the corresponding Baseline throughout the extended training horizon, while CLIP and LPIPS remain comparable. For example, at 10 10 k steps, SALD already achieves substantially lower FID than the Baseline, reducing it from 26.44 26.44 to 23.86 23.86 on MultiGen and from 33.11 33.11 to 27.37 27.37 on Oxford 102 Flowers with SANA 1.6B. Importantly, this advantage does not disappear as training continues, demonstrating that the improvements observed at the main 10 10 k-step setting are not simply a consequence of under-training the Baseline.
blocks.zh: 为了审查主要培训预算所报告的收益是否是基线培训不足的结果,我们把基线模式和SALD模式扩大到100个100公里培训步骤,相当于标准10个10公里培训预算的10x10x10乘。 表7汇报了多Gen和牛津102花卉数据集的SANA 1.6B和SANA 0.6B的结果。 SALD在整个扩大的训练范围内保持了与相应基线相比的一致的FID优势,而CLIP和LPIPS仍然具有可比性. 例如,在10千步时,SALD已经实现了比基线低得多的FID,从MultiGen的26.44 26.44降至23.86 23.86,从33.11 33.11降至27.37 27.37 牛津102花与SANA 1.6B. 重要的是,这一优势不会随着培训的继续而消失,这表明在主要10个10千步设置中观察到的改进不仅仅是基线培训不足的结果。

blocks.en: The extended training results also reveal diminishing returns at later stages of optimization. After approximately 80 80 k steps, both models improve more slowly. SALD maintains a clear FID advantage over the Baseline in this later regime: the gap remains stable on MultiGen ( 2.58 2.58 at both 10 10 k and 100 100 k for SANA 1.6B) and narrows but persists on Oxford 102 Flowers (from 5.74 5.74 to 3.71 3.71 for SANA 1.6B and from 4.81 4.81 to 3.57 3.57 for SANA 0.6B). Thus, extending training to 100 100 k steps does not eliminate the advantage of SALD. Instead, the results demonstrate that the gain introduced by SALD persists throughout the extended training process, while further optimization beyond 80 80 k steps provides only marginal improvements for either method. These observations support the use of 10 10 k steps as a practical training budget for the main experiments and confirm that the reported improvements are not due to premature termination of Baseline training.
blocks.zh: 扩大的培训结果还显示,在优化的后期阶段,回报率不断下降。 经过大约80千米的步法后,两种型号的改进都比较缓慢. SALD在后来的政权中比基线保持明显的FID优势:在MultiGen(10 10k和100 100k为SANA 1.6B的2.58 2.58)和窄线上的差距仍然稳定,但在牛津102朵花(SANA 1.6B的5.74 5.74-3.71.71,SANA 0.6B的4.81 4.81-3.57)。 因此,将培训扩大到100 100千步并不能消除SALD的优势。 相反,结果显示,在扩大培训过程中,SALD带来的收益一直存在,而80千步以外的进一步优化只能使这两种方法都略有改进。 这些意见支持将10个10公里步骤作为主要试验的实际培训预算,并证实所报告的改进并非由于基线培训过早终止。

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: SALD evaluates each training example through two noise levels using the same diffusion model: the lower-noise easy path provides an internal reference under no_grad , whereas the higher-noise hard path supplies the training gradient. Consequently, SALD requires neither an external teacher nor additional trainable model parameters during training or inference. Nevertheless, the additional easy-path evaluation increases the per-step training cost by approximately 25 % 25\% . Although our wall-clock-matched experiments (Table 5 ) show that the resulting improvement in optimization efficiency can offset this overhead, reducing the per-step training cost remains an important direction for future work. One possibility is to cache easy-path reference predictions from earlier checkpoints. However, such cached predictions would become stale as the model changes and would depart from the formulation considered in this work, where the reference is always computed with the current model parameters.
blocks.zh: SALD使用相同的扩散模型通过两个噪声级来评价每个训练实例:低噪声的简单路径在 no_grad下提供内部参考,而高噪声的硬路径则提供训练梯度. 因此,在培训或推论期间,SALD既不需要外部教师,也不需要额外的可培训的模型参数。 然而,附加的便捷路径评价将每步培训费用提高了25%。 尽管我们按时计时的试验(表5)表明,在优化效率方面的改进可以抵消这种间接费用,但降低每步培训费用仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。 一种可能性是缓存以前检查站的简单参考预测。 然而,随着模型的改变,这种缓存的预测将变得僵化,并且将偏离本项工作中考虑的提法,因为本项工作总是用目前的模型参数计算参考。

blocks.en: TAM stores one non-trainable scalar for each training sample. This memory cost is negligible for the dataset sizes considered in our experiments but grows linearly with the number of training examples. Moreover, TAM updates a sample’s memory only when that sample is revisited, so its curriculum effect is weaker when each example is seen only a few times during training. For extremely large web-scale datasets, group-level, clustered, or compressed difficulty statistics could reduce this cost and increase the update frequency, although such approximations may sacrifice the precision of the per-sample curriculum.
blocks.zh: TAM为每个培训样本储存了1个非训练级标尺. 这种内存成本对于我们实验中考虑的数据集大小来说是微不足道的,但随着训练实例的数量而呈线性增长. 此外,TAM只在重新审视样本时更新样本的记忆,因此,每个实例在培训期间只看到几次,其课程效果就比较弱。 对于极其庞大的网络尺度数据集,群级,集群,或压缩难度统计可以降低这一成本并增加更新频率,尽管这种近似可能牺牲每个样本课程的精度.

blocks.en: Finally, our empirical evaluation is limited to fine-tuning pretrained text-to-image flow-matching models; we do not evaluate SALD for training from scratch. Our convergence analysis also holds only for a fixed TAM memory state (Remark 4). While we describe how the same easy–hard self-referencing principle can be extended to DDPM-style noise-prediction objectives, we do not experimentally validate that extension in this work. Evaluating SALD with noise-prediction models, in from-scratch training, and in other generative modalities, including video and 3D generation, remain directions for future research.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的经验评价仅限于微调经过预先培训的文本与图像流匹配模式;我们不从零开始评价SALD的培训。 我们的趋同分析也只针对固定的TAM内存状态(Remark 4). 虽然我们描述了如何将同样的简单而硬的自我参照原则推广到DDPM式噪声预测目标,但我们在这项工作中并没有实验性地验证这种延伸。 利用噪声预测模型评估SALD,从刮伤训练,以及其他基因模式,包括视频和3D生成,仍然是未来研究的方向.
